title: Sprinkler Installation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are head spacing, positions and levels correct to the approved layout and structure?
Is pipework level and square, fittings clean and supports at the correct centres?
Are heads protected and free from paint or damage?
Air test 0.5 bar for 15 min done before the hydraulic test?
Hydraulic test 15 bar for 120 min witnessed by MPX, with CP14 certificate signed?
questions.source: Argus ITP – BS EN 12845 test, CP14

questions.q: Was the test authorised by MPX before it started (no unauthorised tests)?
